violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §747.2319(7))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was observed washing her hands a child's hands after diapering in the kitchen sink, which was also used to clean bottles.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver was observed washing her hands a child's hands after diapering in the kitchen sink, which was also used to clean bottles.
A separate sink for handwashing was not available separate from a sink for bottle washing/food handling.
